hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A bonding curve token launch hook that blocks external liquidity management (beforeInitialize/beforeAddLiquidity/beforeRemoveLiquidity all revert). Newly launched tokens trade on a bonding curve until the supply cap is reached, then the hook automatically migrates liquidity to a standard AMM pool. Each swap incurs a 1% fee split 50/50 between the creator and platform, taken via afterSwapReturnsDelta.
